remarks: Quality to-be-built Essex Home! Nestled in the heart of Lancaster, Essex Lake Estates is a new, limited-opportunity community featuring just 8 exclusive home sites — each offering a rare combination of privacy, expansive space, and truly breathtaking natural beauty. What sets Essex Lake Estates apart is the incredible rear-yard view of a dazzling quarry lake, known for its crystal-clear, vibrant blue water. This stunning tree-lined backdrop creates a peaceful, almost resort-like atmosphere that you simply won't find anywhere else in Western New York. Our Devonshire home plan, features 3,675 sq. ft. of luxury living with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and soaring 9' ceilings on the 1st floor and walk-out basement. A private den with 8' tall french doors and a formal dining room accented with rich crown molding and shadow boxes. Spacious kitchen with professional built-in appliances, oversized island, dry bar, and a spacious walk-in pantry! A 3-car garage offers additional indoor parking and leads to a mudroom with built-in bench/cubbies/coat rack. A luxurious 2nd-floor primary suite with a box ceiling features a glamour bath with a 6' Kohler soaking tub, a spa-worthy tile shower with bench seat, heated flooring, and the walk-in closet of your dreams! Three spacious secondary bedrooms, each with its own bathroom entrances. A large activity room provides an inviting approach on the 2nd floor and access to the 2nd-floor laundry. With Essex Home's Custom Pricing process the purchaser enjoys the ability to customize all finishes and selections, allowing them to value engineer their home based on what's important to them. Images and virtual tour are of a similar home.
